about_the_game:
A cozy fantasy management game where you build and run a tavern for adventurers. Serve humans, dwarves, and elves, gather rumors from your customers, and turn those into quests to grow your fame and expand your tavern.

Key Features

Build & Customize Your Tavern
Design your tavern exactly the way you want. Place furniture, kitchens, beds, lights, and a wide variety of fantasy-inspired decorations. Fill your walls with trophies, banners, mysterious artifacts, and strange curios collected from adventurers’ travels. Create a tavern that feels unique, alive, and deeply rooted in a fantasy world.

Serve a Diverse Crowd
Humans, dwarves, and elves all have different food and drink preferences. Serve them well to earn gold, keep them happy, and improve your reputation. A satisfied tavern brings more visitors and better opportunities.

Rumors into Quests
Progress in Tavern Adventures is driven by stories, not a traditional tech tree.

Listen to the rumors shared by your customers and turn them into quests for brave adventurers. Send heroes to hunt monsters, search for lost treasures, or uncover secrets.

Grow Your Fame
As your reputation increases, unlock new races, advanced recipes, bigger upgrades, and special events that expand your tavern’s possibilities.

Manage with Depth, Play at Your Pace
Hire and assign staff, manage resources, and optimize service flow. Enjoy a low-stress experience that still rewards smart planning and attention to detail.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 Home 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 6100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia® GeForce™ GTX 970 (4 GB) | AMD® Radeon™ RX 480 (8 GB)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10 Home 64 Bit | Windows® 11

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia® GeForce™ GTX 1070 (8 GB) | AMD® Radeon™ RX 5600 XT (8 GB)
